notes: Approved set from the implementation plan dependency policy: MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC, MPL-2.0, PostgreSQL.

LGPL-3.0 is included because the plan's stack table names psycopg under LGPL-3.0. GPL and AGPL stay out of application dependencies; they are allowed only for unmodified standalone services and tools.
0BSD, BlueOak-1.0.0, CC0-1.0, Unlicense, MIT-0 and Python-2.0 are permissive licences that appear in the Node and Python ecosystems and meet the same bar as MIT.
A dependency passes when every AND-clause contains at least one approved licence.
